body.name: agent-skills-state-2026
body.description: Study of 2,999 public agent skill, plugin and MCP repositories (October 2026): missing security policies, unpinned MCP servers, unrestricted shell in skills, front matter that fails to parse. Dataset (CC BY 4.0), method, hand-checked precision and scripts.

body.name: use-cases-portal
body.description: AIMarket use-cases portal — public wow, onboarding (See·Buy·Publish·Build·Invest), live rails, and 7 direction boards with 12 idea pages (3D previews). Static site, five languages, honest LIVE vs SIM. Live host use.modelmarket.dev; Pages landing (docs/landing/) at alexar76.github.io/use-cases-portal.

body.name: domain-operator-kit
body.description: Independent domain operators: signed domains.*@v1 quotes, fixed markup, registration, renewal and DNS. Openprovider, Porkbun Sandbox or HTTP suppliers; x402 USDC on Base and a buyer-side Vercel connector. Pre-live: both sandbox pilots passed; production payments and Vercel remain unverified.

body.name: esim-operator-kit
body.description: Onboard any eSIM operator, including ones already selling. They offer travel eSIMs to people and AI agents on AIMarket rails and get paid however they already take payment. Storefront in 5 languages. Demo: esim.modelmarket.dev.

body.name: cite-desks
body.description: Cite desks — independent evidence desks on AIMarket rails. One parent repo: shared kernel plus Emberline (fire), Tideline (flood), Solrecord (PV), Seamark (Nordic AIS), Plinth (site) and Smokeproof (HMS smoke), each a nested project with its own README. Family landing: desk.modelmarket.dev. Not an AIMarket brand surface.

body.name: attested-memory
body.description: Attested Memory — verifiable memory for AI agents: Memory Market (write, search, share), Truth Layer (evidence and contradictions) and Provenance Ledger (lineage, hybrid-signed receipts) around one Memory Unit contract, with an MCP endpoint. Self-hosted, Docker.

body.name: dolos
body.description: DOLOS — dynamic EVM red team for the UNI bubble: fork-isolated exploit txs, Ed25519 findings, sandbox fix-loop only.

body.name: escrow-signer
body.description: HORKOS holds the only key authorized in AIMarketEscrow.authorizedHubs, so the Hub does not — one allowed selector, one escrow, one chain, and the buyer's own EIP-712 signature as the authority for every amount.

body.name: basanos
body.description: BASANOS checks ecosystem Solidity at a pinned commit — Ed25519-signed PASS/REVIEW/FAIL verdicts with evidence and an operator playbook. (Assurance, not insurance or admission.)

body.name: emporion
body.description: EMPORION — public-record facts for agents that trade: EU VAT (VIES), legal entities (GLEIF LEI), company registers, EORI, domains (RDAP), ECB rates, sanctions lists (OFAC with wallets, EU, UK), business days, Bitcoin timestamps, web evidence captures and dead man's switch timers — every answer signed with its source, fetch time and SHA-256.

body.name: histor
body.description: HISTOR — public transparency log of MCP tool definitions: reads what remote MCP endpoints in the official registry advertise (never calls a tool), signs it as MTL/1 labels, appends them to an RFC 9162 Merkle log, and answers /check: is what a client received what was observed? Never calls a server safe.

body.name: hestia
body.description: HESTIA — the hosted runtime: isolated, for AIMarket capability providers on the operator’s machines. Not a Hub catalogue, not a job board, not Factory. Agents appear only after a signed deploy onto this host.

body.name: themis
body.description: THEMIS — publish-time admission gate for AIMarket: signed approve/review/reject for AI-agent supply-chain procurement (not Metis, not WARDEN).

body.name: create-aimarket-agent
body.description: Standalone CLI that scaffolds tested AIMarket Protocol v2 capability providers with manifests and Docker packaging.

body.name: aimarket-playground
body.description: Zero-setup guided AIMarket golden path: GAIA invoke, Metis verification, signed Hub receipt, and Alien Monitor handoff.

body.name: signal-hunt
body.description: Signal Hunt — federation-native investigation game and educational laboratory over real AIMarket Hub telemetry. Observe measured symptoms, commit a diagnosis, prove it with a reproducible Brier-score verdict. Each round is a live lab on federation literacy. Live data only; no seeded anomalies.

body.name: logos
body.description: LOGOS — federation analytics engine. Cross-hub query, anomaly detection, NL insights via Metis council. The analytical brain of the AIMarket federation. One node, every insight.

body.name: treasury
body.description: MOMUS Treasury — the separate payer role that releases red-team bounties only on independent verification; MOMUS finds and signs, the Treasury (its own key) pays.

body.name: momus
body.description: MOMUS — autonomous adversarial-audit (red team) satellite: safe, read-only conformance probes against the ecosystem's own components, emitted as Ed25519-signed findings; a separate Treasury role pays bounties only on independent verification.

body.name: gaia
body.description: GAIA — physical-world oracle gateway: Ed25519-attested gaia.*.read@v1 relays (weather, FIRMS, GLM lightning, NWS flood/alerts, EFFIS, volcano, EONET, SWPC, GNSS jamming) plus window/verify. LIVE only with provenance.

body.name: atlas
body.description: ATLAS — planetary physical-sensor map over GAIA (LIVE/SIM layers including fire, flood, lightning, alerts, EFFIS, volcano) with Hub composites situation.brief / fire.weather / nearest / watchbox, DeepSeek Analyst, and Alien Monitor embed.

body.name: skopos
body.description: SKOPOS (Σκοπός) — self-hosted nginx analytics and fleet security for the AICOM ecosystem. SSH log collection, Security Center with 3D threat map, scan history, and an AI agent with voice input.

body.name: metis
body.description: Metis (μῆτις) — distributed cognitive layer over any LLM. Understanding Council → confidence gate (fail-closed) → layered MoA → verifier-with-retry, with DGPD depth gating, memory, economy metering, and an OpenAI-compatible API. A loosely-coupled ecosystem peer: runs fully standalone; every ecosystem hook is optional.

body.name: aimarket-mcp
body.description: Ecosystem MCP gateway — web fetch/search + Metis verify behind one SSRF-hardened MCP endpoint (Streamable-HTTP). Consumed by Metis and ARGUS via the aimarket-web preset.

body.name: hephaestus
body.description: HEPHAESTUS — the forge: compose capability chains from the live signed AIMarket catalogue, price the graph before you spend, run it, and keep a signed bill of materials with hop-level blame.

body.name: helios
body.description: HELIOS — self-hosted broadcast pipeline for the AIMarket ecosystem. Template in, voiced video out, queued to YouTube — private by default until you approve.

body.name: dioscuri
body.description: DIOSCURI — one mind, two heavens. Twin community agents: CASTOR rides Telegram, POLLUX holds Discord. Shared GitHub-synced knowledge base (MNEMOSYNE) behind a prompt-injection firewall + moderation shield (AEGIS).

body.name: theoros
body.description: THEOROS — Agent Sovereignty Canon. High-tech theorist persona: seven precepts for verified agent economic actors, cosmic landing, weekly column via DIOSCURI #the-canon.

body.name: warden
body.description: WARDEN — MCP security firewall: vets an MCP server's tool definitions against static-scan rules, a signed threat feed, origin and tool-def pinning before any tool reaches the model. Zero-dependency TypeScript library.

body.name: argus
body.description: ARGUS-3 — wallet-native, security-hardened personal agent; demand-side reference client and the reference host for the WARDEN MCP firewall (@aimarket/warden, a separate package) plus native AIMarket consumer/provider. Owner-locked Telegram, multi-provider, autonomous offline.

body.name: lottery
